Recorded claim:
In D200823 the reviewer requested a dedicated module logger in place of direct console warnings, pointing to the existing mimeDecrypt.sys.mjs pattern. The landed RNP module creates a pref-controlled logger with the openpgp prefix and uses lazy.log.warn for existing and imported problematic keys. This is a scoped logging convention for OpenPGP modules and is visible across nearby current OpenPGP files.
